review_candidates.title: Windows/Virtualization/ADFS – Associate Manager Infrastructure Services
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Windows Server platforms (AD, ADFS, GPOs, DNS, DHCP) and lead VMware ESXi/vCenter (or Hyper-V) virtualization environments. Maintain comprehensive documentation (CMDB integrity, runbooks, VM lifecycle). Required Skills & Qualifications Advanced experience with Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, ADFS, GPO, DNS, DHCP. 8+ years of combined experience in Windows Server and virtualization engineering. VMware Certified Pro
eligibility_evidence: VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Microsoft equivalent (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate), ITIL Foundation preferred.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Skills & Qualifications Advanced experience with Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, ADFS, GPO, DNS, DHCP. Highly proficient in scripting (PowerShell, Ansible, PowerCLI) and tools like SCCM/WSUS. 8+ years of combined experience in Windows Server and virtualization engineering.
